1.6
Versioning and Localization
This document specifies the structures for the following versions of RDL:<1>
RDL XML Schema for Version 2003/10 (RDL200310)

RDL XML Schema for Version 2005/01 (RDL200501)

RDL XML Schema for Version 2008/01 (RDL200801)

RDL XML Schema for Version 2010/01 (RDL201001)

RDL XML Schema for Version 2011/01 (RDL201101)

RDL XML Schema for Version 2012/01 (RDL201201)

RDL XML Schema for Version 2013/01 (RDL201301)

RDL XML Schema for Version 2016/01 (RDL201601)

These versions are defined in Appendix A: RDL XML Schemas (section 5).
There are no localization-dependent structures in the RDL file format.
